edges.reason: mint reads totalSupply() into local supply.
mint enforces and increments publicMint[msg.sender] cap of 20.
mint requires public_paused to be false.
mint checks batchCount < 555 and increments it.
mint requires supply < maxSupply.
mint requires msg.value >= cost for non-owner callers.
msg.sender determines mint eligibility and per-wallet cap.
msg.sender is compared with owner() to waive payment in mint.
mint calls nextToken() to obtain the token id.
nextToken returns the generated token id to mint.
Local id in mint is assigned from nextToken return value.
mint calls _safeMint which can invoke an external receiver.
presale_mint reads totalSupply() into local supply.
presale_mint enforces and increments preMint[msg.sender] cap of 10.
presale_mint requires pre_paused to be false.
presale_mint checks batchCount < 555 and increments it.
presale_mint requires presaleWallets[msg.sender] to be true.
presale_mint requires supply < maxSupply.
presale_mint requires msg.value >= presaleCost.
msg.sender drives whitelist and cap checks in presale_mint.
presale_mint calls nextToken() to obtain the token id.
nextToken returns the generated token id to presale_mint.
Local id in presale_mint is assigned from nextToken return value.
presale_mint calls _safeMint which can invoke an external receiver.
tokenURI consumes the tokenId parameter.
tokenURI reads baseURI state variable.
tokenURI appends baseExtension to the produced URI.
tokenURI caches the internal base URI in local currentBaseURI.
onlyOwner compares owner() derived from _owner with the caller.
onlyOwner validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
setCost is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setPresaleCost is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseExtension is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
startNewBatch is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
startPublicSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
startPreSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
stopPublicSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
stopPreSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
addPresaleUser is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
add50PresaleUsers is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
removePresaleUser is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCost writes the cost state variable.
setCost consumes its _newCost parameter.
setPresaleCost writes the presaleCost state variable.
setPresaleCost consumes its _newCost parameter.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
setBaseURI consumes its _newBaseURI parameter.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension state variable.
setBaseExtension consumes its _newBaseExtension parameter.
startNewBatch resets batchCount to zero.
startPublicSale sets public_paused to false.
startPreSale sets pre_paused to false.
stopPublicSale sets public_paused to true.
stopPreSale sets pre_paused to true.
addPresaleUser sets presaleWallets[_user] to true.
addPresaleUser consumes its _user parameter.
add50PresaleUsers writes presaleWallets for 50 entries.
add50PresaleUsers consumes its _users array parameter.
removePresaleUser sets presaleWallets[_user] to false.
removePresaleUser consumes its _user parameter.
withdraw requires msg.sender to equal owner1 or owner2.
withdraw reads owner1 for authorization and payout.
withdraw reads owner2 for authorization and payout.
withdraw assigns local share = 60.
withdraw computes local amount from the contract balance.
withdraw multiplies balance by share and divides by 100.
withdraw performs external ETH transfers to owner1 and owner2.
block.timestamp is consumed in nextToken pseudo-randomness.
msg.sender is part of the keccak256 randomness input.
nextToken computes a keccak256 hash over miner-influenced values.
nextToken reduces the hash modulo maxIndex into local random.
nextToken computes maxIndex = tSupply() - tokenCount().
nextToken relies on availableTokenCount subtraction for bounds.
nextToken reads _totalSupply through tSupply().
nextToken reads and increments the _tokenCount counter.
nextToken reads and writes the tokenMatrix mapping.
nextToken adds startFrom to the assigned token id.
nextToken obtains the token id value from tokenMatrix.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_safeMint triggers an external receiver callback that can reenter.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() to the receiver.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
constructor calls setBaseURI, which is onlyOwner gated.
constructor passes maxSupply into RandomlyAssigned.
constructor sets startFrom to 1.

normalization_plan.reason: _newCost is only meaningful as the price argument written into the cost state variable by setCost.
_newBaseURI is the argument that is stored directly into baseURI by setBaseURI.
_newBaseExtension is the argument written into baseExtension by setBaseExtension.
_user is only used to set presaleWallets[_user] inside addPresaleUser.
_users array is only iterated to write presaleWallets inside add50PresaleUsers.
_user_remove is only used to clear presaleWallets inside removePresaleUser.
tokenId is the only argument consumed by tokenURI to build the metadata URI.
supply_mint is a transient snapshot of totalSupply() used for the maxSupply check in mint.
id_mint holds the nextToken() result that mint immediately passes to _safeMint.
supply_presale is a transient totalSupply() snapshot used only in presale_mint.
id_presale holds the nextToken() result used only inside presale_mint.
currentBaseURI is a temporary cache of _baseURI() used solely to build the tokenURI string.
share is a constant 60 used only in the withdraw payout computation.
amount is the derived payout value transferred to owner1 inside withdraw.
random is the keccak-derived index used only to index tokenMatrix in nextToken.
maxIndex is the remaining supply figure computed and consumed inside nextToken.
value is the matrix-derived token id returned by nextToken.
